actions.description: Move the axes to absolute positions in micrometres and wait until the stage is idle. The array names the leading axes in order; trailing axes keep their current position.

inputs.description: Absolute target position in micrometres for the leading axes, in axis order
inputs.name: positions

actions.name: move_absolute

outputs.description: Position of every axis in micrometres after the motion
outputs.name: positions

outputs.description: True when the move reached the idle state
outputs.name: moved

actions.description: Move the axes by relative displacements in micrometres and wait until the stage is idle. The array names the leading axes in order; trailing axes do not move.

inputs.description: Relative displacement in micrometres for the leading axes, in axis order
inputs.name: displacements

actions.name: move_relative

outputs.description: Position of every axis in micrometres after the motion
outputs.name: positions

outputs.description: True when the move reached the idle state
outputs.name: moved

actions.description: Home every axis with the native force homing and report whether every axis is homed. It takes no input.
actions.name: home_axes

outputs.description: True once every axis reports itself homed
outputs.name: homed

actions.description: Stop all motion on the resource with a declared deceleration profile and report the stopping position. This capability is always cancellable=false and is exempt from rate limiting.

inputs.description: Requested deceleration; the native stop takes no deceleration argument and uses the device's configured stop profile, so the value is accepted but does not change the call
inputs.name: deceleration

actions.name: stop_motion

facts.text: The README states that units of distance are always given in micrometres
ZaberStage sets the Zaber library length unit to LENGTH_MICROMETRES
ZaberStage.connectStage opens the Zaber ASCII serial connection, enables alerts and builds one axis from every detected device
ZaberStage.move_absolute sends every axis its target position in the stage unit and, when wait_until_idle is true, waits until all axes are idle
ZaberStage.move_relative sends every axis its displacement in the stage unit and, when wait_until_idle is true, waits until all axes are idle
ZaberStage.get_position reads every axis position in the stage unit
UniversalStage.home homes every axis that is not homed, or every axis when force is true
UniversalStage.stop calls stop() on every axis
UniversalStage.is_moving is true when any axis reports is_busy
UniversalStage.is_homed returns one entry per axis
The README says a stage typically has 2 or 3 axes (x, y, z)
The clone provides DummyStage as a fake stage for troubleshooting

measures.description: Position of every axis in micrometres, in the order the stage reports its axes
measures.name: position

measures.description: True while any axis reports that it is moving
measures.name: moving

measures.description: One entry per axis: true when that axis reports itself homed
measures.name: homed

operator_required.name: move_absolute
operator_required.reason: no text in the clone states the travel range of the stage or of the stage mounted on the controller; the permitted target range depends on the installed stage and is a site decision (site-limits.example.json shows the overlay)

operator_required.name: move_relative
operator_required.reason: no text in the clone states the travel range of the stage; the permitted relative displacement of the installed stage is a site decision, and a per-call bound cannot replace an absolute travel envelope

safe_state.description: all axes stopped; the native stop() is called on every axis
